abstention_card.missing_datum: A transcript-level NMD measurement on a recorded WWOX nonsense allele (with and without an NMD-discriminating arm). The enumeration is supplied since 2026-10-28 as a PREDICTION from sequence: 32 single-nucleotide stop-gained alleles of NM_016373.4 in the repository ClinVar snapshot (undated), 23 predicted NMD-sensitive, 1 borderline, 8 predicted to escape, the five census read-through-candidate alleles all predicted NMD-sensitive; the 50-55 nt rule is a prediction, never a measurement, and no WWOX NMD or read-through measurement exists. Caveat carried from the E1a note and its independent verification: the unmeasured intron-8 retention outcome predicted for the exon-9 acceptor splice allele would create a stop codon, so even the inference 'no applicable target in the reference genotype class' rests on an unmeasured prediction about that allele.
abstention_card.search_record: NON_TROVATO_NELLA_RICERCA, bounded. The zero for the agent names ataluren, PTC124 and ELX-02 was found in the sweep of the WWOX-literature bodies (analysis/wwox_nmd_assay_census_20260922.md) and not across the whole repository: analysis/woree_therapeutic_class_census_20260921.md carries a READ-THROUGH class row naming an ataluren class, and analysis/ft116_cohort_triage_20260921.md calls p.(Arg264Ter) a READ-THROUGH candidate; neither is a WWOX measurement. PubMed WWOX with those terms returned 0 on 2026-10-20 in title/abstract only; not re-runnable offline.

card_conventions: IPOTESI throughout; the bridge forces it. No score, rank, probability or blended index is carried, and none may be derived from this card.

directional_summary compares signs only where target, endpoint and every context dimension match; UNRESOLVED means no matched comparison exists, which is a statement about the record, not about the biology.
NO_MATCH_FOUND is not 'does not exist'; NON_TROVATO_NELLA_RICERCA is not MAI_TENTATO.
label_lookup is NOT_ATTEMPTED on every card: the bridge has no network and no pharmacological-label search was run. It is not NO_MATCH_FOUND.
No dose, route, schedule or paediatric suitability appears; concentrations or exposures of the sources are deliberately not reproduced.
Every adjacent source is labelled NOT WWOX EVIDENCE at class level.
no_new_reading: No paper was opened for this card; the sources are the repository's own receipted notes and records.
